categories.label: Visible surface crack
categories.scope: Installed experimental crack model. Two reused ev-CIVIL public diagnostic clips:136/170 publisher boxes matched at IoU0.50; thin-crack case0/8. Unknown training overlap; no independent Saudi or all-stage validation.

categories.label: Spalling / surface material loss
categories.scope: Installed DACL512 photo diagnostic only: 36 positive and19 class-absent public photos; checkpoint training/selection overlap unknown. Pixel precision69.9%, recall34.5%, IoU.30033;12/101 derived regions matched at IoU.50;7/19 class-absent photos flagged. Weak photo localization does not establish spalling video detection. The old installed crack-only video baseline is unsupported for spalling; the new video fit is separate.

categories.label: Rust / corrosion staining
categories.scope: DACL512 photo diagnostic: pixel precision 69.2%, recall 21.0%, IoU 19.2%; derived-region matches 26/119 at IoU0.50, 66 unmatched model regions; class-absent photo flags 5/25. 55 fixed public-validation stills; checkpoint overlap unknown. No category-specific video validation.

categories.label: Visible tile surface texture anomaly
categories.scope: Research on 117 real manufacturing tile photos, with 48 normal fit and 10 normal calibration photos. Crack pixel precision 31.14%, recall 59.71%, IoU 25.73%; 0/17 derived crack regions matched at IoU 0.50. Normal photos: 3/33 flagged. These results also hold after the actual serving component filter for crack and normal cases. No installed-floor or video validation.

categories.label: Wall material moisture content
categories.scope: Requires a calibrated instrument appropriate to the material. A visible wet spot does not measure water content or establish a hidden leak.

categories.label: Room relative humidity
categories.scope: Requires a temperature/RH sensor with calibration, units, time and location. It cannot be inferred from wall color.

categories.label: Peeling or flaking wall paint
categories.scope: Existing generic material-loss detections do not identify paint. Related wall data are acquired; no paint-specific local detector is validated.

categories.label: Paint blister or bubble appearance
categories.scope: Requires paint-specific supervision. A generic publisher bulge label is not a material-verified paint blister.

categories.label: Paint coverage/run/color mismatch
categories.scope: Requires an approved reference and controlled illumination. No trained detector or suitable evaluation dataset is verified.

categories.label: Cracked installed ceramic
categories.scope: The tile anomaly specialist is related manufacturing research only: 0/17 derived crack regions matched at IoU 0.50. Installed tiles, decorative veins and grout are not validated.

categories.label: Tile joint gap, skew or shift
categories.scope: Requires calibrated same-plane geometry and the approved grid or nominal gap. No installed-video ground truth or model is validated.

categories.label: Surface flatness or tile lippage
categories.scope: Requires depth, a straightedge or a scan reference. A 2D image homography does not measure height.

categories.label: Fastener/anchorage and other installation defects
categories.scope: No installed model verifies screw engagement, torque, anchor embedment, required fastening arrangement or capacity. Object/crack detections do not establish fastening adequacy.
